Title: Azure DevTest discounts are now available

Body.Content:
Simplify the management experience of your Windows virtual machines (VMs) and easily deploy and scale your development and testing environments, all with special discounts, by accessing the Windows Virtual Desktop service within your Azure DevTest subscription.

Learn more
